account.tooLong: Account code must be at most {{max}} characters
account.whitespace: Account code must not have leading or trailing whitespace
account.printable: Account code must contain only printable characters

asset.required: Asset is required for this scope
asset.tooLong: Asset must be at most {{max}} characters

accountGroup.required: Account group is required for this scope
accountGroup.tooLong: Account group must be at most {{max}} characters
accountGroup.whitespace: Account group must not have leading or trailing whitespace
accountGroup.printable: Account group must contain only printable characters

maxOrders.integer: max_orders must be an integer greater than 0

window.duration: window must be a positive Go duration (e.g. 1s, 500ms)

limit.scopeNoAccount: scope {{scope}} must not carry an account
limit.scopeNoAsset: scope {{scope}} must not carry an asset
limit.scopeNoAccountGroup: scope {{scope}} must not carry an account group
limit.policyNoAccountGroup: {{policy}} must not carry an account group
limit.rateLimitRequires: rate_limit requires both max_orders and window
limit.orderSizeUnderlyingNoNotional: an underlying-asset scope must not carry max_notional
limit.orderSizeSettlementNoQuantity: a settlement-asset scope must not carry max_quantity
